claims.text: Unresectable: nivolumab (PD-1) + ipilimumab (CTLA-4), FDA-approved; improved overall survival.
claims.quote: Immunotherapy: Combination immune checkpoint inhibitors, such as nivolumab (PD-1 inhibitor) and ipilimumab (CTLA-4 inhibitor), are FDA-approved for unresectable mesothelioma, demonstrating improved overall survival in clinical trials.
